title: Desk Note on Booking the Charge for an Agreed Change of Specification
content:
# Desk Note on Booking the Charge for an Agreed Change of Specification

Where a change to the specification of a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions has been agreed, the charge for that change is priced onto the commission, raising what the customer owes on it. The charge for the agreed change is worked out only after the studio's request record carries the customer's own confirmation of the change and of what the work it puts back on the bench is worth.

Put the other way: until the studio's request record carries that confirmation of the change, standing as confirmed by the customer and bearing what the work the change puts back on the bench is worth, the charge for the agreed change is not yet worked out.

## What the booking does

One call books a single charge entry against the commission for the named change, raising what the customer owes on that commission by the amount given and leaving the quoted total, the design revisions and the production stage exactly as they were. The customer sees the charge on their commission file against the change reference it prices.

## How the charge is booked

The charge is booked on the studio's own tool `charge_specification_change_ec6b5130`. The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `custom_order_id` | The commission record the charge is booked against | An identifier, as read from the design studio's commission lookup for this customer |
| `commission_reference` | The reference the customer is given for the commission being charged | CO- followed by six digits, for example CO-509314, exactly as it stands on the commission record |
| `change_order_reference` | The change this charge prices | CH- followed by six digits, for example CH-208551, exactly as it stands on the studio's request record |
| `change_charge_amount` | The amount booked against the commission for the change | In USD, to 2 decimal places, rounded half up, positive, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol |

## What comes back

A single line of text confirming the charge was booked. It names the new commission entry's reference number, the commission reference it was booked to, the change order reference it prices and the amount booked in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that line is what indicates the commission now carries the charge.
